subject: chem
title: Chemical Energetics
subtitle: Chemical Energetics with core theory, reaction logic, and exam-focused application.
concept: Energetics tracks energy transfer during chemical change. The sign and magnitude of enthalpy change determine whether a process releases energy to surroundings or absorbs energy from them.
At constant pressure, delta H measures heat transferred. Exothermic reactions have negative delta H because products are at lower enthalpy than reactants.
The deeper exam skill is using pathway independence. Hess law allows indirect calculations when direct measurement is difficult or impossible.
